what: New Etsy seller reports permanent suspension for failing to manually update tracking numbers for two Printify T-shirt orders, stating they submitted four appeals and multiple emails without receiving a clear explanation.
verbatim_snippet: "As a new seller, I failed to manually update the tracking numbers for two Printify T-shirt orders. I genuinely believed they would sync automatically, as they had with my candle orders. I now understand that it was my responsibility. These orders were shipped on time by Printify, but I believe my failure to update the tracking contributed to the suspension. This was never an attempt to ignore Etsy's policies. I was doing my best, but I made a mistake due to my inexperience. Since the suspension, I've submitted four appeals and sent multiple emails, but I haven't received a clear explanation or the opportunity to speak with someone directly."
notes: community.etsy.com requires login. Content retrieved from Google search index. Poster: SunlitReverieStudio. New seller (shop opened end of December 2024). Products: T-shirts (via Printify) and candles. Production partner: Printify. 4 appeals submitted.
